title: Where she lives and the Irish Channel boundary
summary: She gives her address, says her neighborhood is not the Irish Channel, and describes living around the city and hearing jazz nearby.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: We're at 3143 Tipper Mall. We don't put Irish Channel because it's not. I wrote a piece with a French Quarter paper about the expressway and they put Irish Channel on it.
But you don't consider this Irish Channel? No, I don't. Where is Irish Channel?
Irish Channel is down to where the project is. Or the St. Thomas Project there? Yeah, around that way. I used to live there. If it was Irish Channel, there were some mighty nice people living there.
But did you live in this neighborhood all your lives? No, I haven't. Where all have you lived?
I lived all over the city.
I never did live in Newport and Louisiana Avenue to Felicity Street.
From Louisiana to Felicity? Yeah. And from Chippewa, how far back?
That's all. Where's back? I lived in Louisiana in 1928. My aunt, she died and I came here. Pretty much all the other across the street.
How far back towards the lake did you get? Never did. Always along Chippewa Street.

Mr. Golda lived back. They're too quiet for me. I like it. They got a ball in the corner and they hear all the music and the jazz every night. I don't know why I never went. I walked to the center and hear the music.
